async def act(page):
    # Fill the search box with 'OPT model' to filter for OPT-related questions
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search or filter results...").fill("OPT model")
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the search results to load
    
    # Collect all issue links from the page after filtering
    issue_links = await page.get_by_role("link").all()
    issues_list = []
    for link in issue_links:
        href = await link.get_attribute("href")
        if href and "/root/metaseq/issues/" in href:  # Filter for issue links specific to this project
            text_content = await link.text_content()
            issues_list.append(text_content.strip() if text_content else href)
    
    # Return the list of issues as a string for terminate_with_result
    return str(issues_list)
